title: 八声甘州（对潇潇暮雨洒江天）
titleEn: Eight Beats of Ganzhou (Evening Rain over the River)
author: 柳永
intro: A traveller stands in a tower as autumn rain clears over the river, and everything he sees turns into homesickness. Then the poem flips: he imagines the woman at home, watching the river for his boat.
analysis: 这是柳永写羁旅（长期在外漂泊）的名篇。上阕写景：一场傍晚的秋雨洗过江天，冷风越吹越紧，山河冷清，夕阳正照着他站的楼。花叶凋零，只有长江水默默向东流——“无语”二字，把江水写得像人一样沉默。下阕抒情：他不敢登高远望，因为一望就想家；又问自己，这些年为什么苦苦留在外地？最妙的是“想佳人”几句：他不直接说自己想她，而是想象她在楼上一次次看江上的船，以为是他回来了，又一次次失望。最后再回到自己：她怎么知道，我此刻也正靠着栏杆发愁呢？这种从对方写起、两地相望的写法，让思念更深。据说苏轼称赞“霜风凄紧，关河冷落，残照当楼”三句不比唐诗最好的句子差。
analysisEn: Liu Yong spent much of his life on the road, and this is his best-known poem about it. The first half is all scenery: an evening shower has rinsed the sky over the river, the frosty wind grows sharper, the land lies cold and empty, and the last light of the sun falls on the tower where he stands. Flowers and leaves are fading; only the Yangtze keeps flowing east, “without a word” — the river is as silent as a person holding back his feelings. The second half turns inward. He can’t bear to climb high and look into the distance, because looking means thinking of home. Why has he stayed away so long? Then comes the most famous move: instead of saying he misses her, he imagines her at her window, watching boats on the horizon and thinking, again and again, that one of them is his. The last lines swing back to him: how could she know that at this very moment he is leaning on a railing, just as sad? Writing a feeling from both ends of the distance is a favourite technique of Chinese poets. Su Shi is said to have praised the lines about the frosty wind and the setting sun as equal to the best of Tang poetry.
background: Liu Yong (c. 984 – c. 1053) failed the civil-service exam several times and made his name writing song lyrics for entertainers in the capital, Kaifeng. He passed late in life and spent his career in minor posts far from home, which is the world of this poem.
pronunciation: 领字“渐”读 jiàn。“是处”“倚阑干处”的“处”读 chù。“红衰”的“衰”读 shuāi。“当楼”的“当”读 dāng（正对着）。颙望 yóng wàng（颙是生僻字）。“恁”读 nèn（如此、这样），不读 rèn。“归思”的“思”按统编教材读 sī；旧读 sì（名词，心绪）。“争知我”的“争”同“怎”，仍读 zhēng。
version: 采用通行文本（《乐章集》，高中语文教材选文）。“惟有长江水”有的本子作“唯有”；“倚阑干处”有的作“倚栏杆处”，意思相同。按句读分行，上下阕各六行。

lines.py: duì xiāo xiāo mù yǔ sǎ jiāng tiān
lines.lit: Facing the pattering evening rain sprinkled over river and sky,
lines.en: Before me, a soft evening rain sweeps across the river and the sky,

lines.lit: one shower washes the clear autumn.
lines.en: and leaves the autumn rinsed and clear.

lines.lit: Gradually the frosty wind grows cold and tight;
lines.en: Little by little the frosty wind bites harder;

lines.py: guān hé lěng luò, cán zhào dāng lóu
lines.lit: passes and rivers lie desolate; the remaining sunlight faces the tower.
lines.en: the hills and rivers lie bare, and the last of the sun falls on my tower.

lines.zh: 是处红衰翠减，苒苒物华休。
lines.rhythm: 是处/红衰/翠减，苒苒/物华休
lines.py: shì chù hóng shuāi cuì jiǎn, rǎn rǎn wù huá xiū
lines.lit: Everywhere red fades and green thins; slowly the beauty of things comes to an end.
lines.en: Everywhere the reds are fading, the greens are thinning; slowly the year’s bright things wind down.

lines.py: wéi yǒu cháng jiāng shuǐ, wú yǔ dōng liú
lines.lit: Only the water of the Long River, without words, flows east.
lines.en: Only the Yangtze keeps going, flowing east without a word.

lines.py: bù rěn dēng gāo lín yuǎn
lines.lit: I cannot bear to climb high and look far,
lines.en: I can’t bear to climb up and gaze into the distance —

lines.py: wàng gù xiāng miǎo miǎo, guī sī nán shōu
lines.lit: looking toward my old home, so remote — thoughts of return are hard to hold back.
lines.en: home is so far away, and once I look, the longing to go back won’t stop.

lines.zh: 叹年来踪迹，何事苦淹留？
lines.rhythm: 叹/年来/踪迹，何事/苦淹留
lines.py: tàn nián lái zōng jì, hé shì kǔ yān liú
lines.lit: I sigh over my tracks these years: for what reason do I bitterly linger?
lines.en: I sigh at where my years have taken me — why do I stay away so long?

lines.py: xiǎng jiā rén zhuāng lóu yóng wàng
lines.lit: I imagine the fair one gazing up and out from her dressing tower,
lines.en: I picture her at her window, looking out and waiting,

lines.py: wù jǐ huí, tiān jì shí guī zhōu
lines.lit: mistaken how many times — at the sky’s edge taking a boat for my returning boat.
lines.en: how many times has she seen a far-off sail and thought, at last, it’s him?

lines.zh: 争知我，倚阑干处，正恁凝愁！
lines.rhythm: 争知我，倚/阑干处，正恁/凝愁
lines.py: zhēng zhī wǒ, yǐ lán gān chù, zhèng nèn níng chóu
lines.lit: How could she know that I, leaning on the railing, am just so deep in sorrow!
lines.en: How could she know that I, leaning on a railing far away, am just as lost in sorrow?
lines.tts: 争知我，倚阑干处，正嫩凝愁！

words.note: 形容风雨声，书面语仍用，如“风雨潇潇”。

words.en: mountain passes and rivers; the land
the last light of the setting sun
words.note: 现代汉语说“夕阳”“落日余晖”。
古义：是＝凡是，处处。和今天的“是”不同。

words.en: the reds fade and the greens thin out
to stay on for a long time
words.note: 古义：久留。和今天的“淹”（被水淹）无关。

words.en: to gaze up and wait eagerly

words.note: 愁像凝固了一样化不开。

imagery.name: 雨
imagery.zh: 傍晚一场秋雨把天地洗得清冷，为全词定下凄凉的调子。
imagery.en: An evening autumn rain washes the world cold and clear, setting the mood for everything that follows.

imagery.name: 夕阳
imagery.zh: “残照当楼”：快落下的太阳照着他，一天将尽，一年也将尽，人却还在外面。
imagery.en: The last sunlight hits his tower: the day is ending, the year is ending, and he is still far from home.

imagery.name: 长江
imagery.zh: 江水“无语东流”，像他一样把话憋在心里；江水向东而去，他却回不去。
imagery.en: The river flows east “without a word”, as silent as he is — it keeps moving on while he cannot go home.

imagery.name: 楼
imagery.zh: 两座楼遥遥相对：他靠在这边的楼上，她在家乡的妆楼上望他。
imagery.en: Two towers face each other across the distance: he leans on one, she watches from the other.

imagery.name: 船
imagery.zh: “归舟”是她盼望的船，一次次认错，写出等待的苦。
imagery.en: The “returning boat” is what she keeps hoping to see — and keeps mistaking — which shows how long she has waited.
